question: Can the s020 filter pipeline run at cohort scale (100 seeds) with a geo-fail gate, and what is the bracket coverage across the cohort?
hypothesis: Gating the geo-fail alignment pass makes the pipeline cohort-cheap and the bracket subsampling preserves s019-level omega-mag coverage.
narrative_md: A geo-fail gate dropped seed-6 wall 49x (3684s -> 75s); full 100-seed cohort ran in 266 min (78 OK, 19 zero-classifiable matching s018b exactly, 2 bug-related). Headline: bracket subsampling (top-N LS peaks) collapses cohort omega-mag coverage to 4/79 within 5% (median 32% off) — contradicting s019's 98/100 on the full grid. Seed 6's 4.6% (the s031 test case) was in the best decile, so s031's pessimism measured a subsampling artifact, not a framework limit.
